title: LiveSecBench: A Dynamic and Event-Driven Safety Benchmark for Chinese Language Model Applications

bias_targets.methodology: Head-to-head evaluation of model responses to adversarial prompts (generated using wrapping, injection, and obfuscation strategies) using an LLM-as-a-judge (DeepSeek-V3.2) and an ELO rating system to assess the generation of biased, discriminatory, or stereotypical content against specific groups.
